title.en: Attentive clinicians and welcoming front desk

text.en: Clients frequently praise the veterinarians and support team for their compassionate, patient manner during visits. Multiple pet owners highlight doctors such as Dr. Leidy and Dr. Kaldis for thorough consultations, cheerful attitudes, and clear explanations, noting that staff make both routine and urgent appointments stress-free.

title.en: Dedicated care for exotics and dogs

text.en: Reviewers emphasize the clinic's specialized willingness and skill in handling exotic pets alongside traditional companion animals. Owners of guinea pigs, pet birds, rats, and senior dogs report gentle physical examinations, careful monitoring, and dedicated medical attention tailored to delicate species.

Pet owners report positive treatment outcomes across surgeries, beak trims, and complex diagnostic evaluations. Multiple clients describe successful tumor removals and effective medication regimens that helped their pets recover comfortably, praising the team for diligent post-procedure follow-ups.

q.en: Does the clinic treat exotic pets like birds, rats, and guinea pigs?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently note that the veterinary team provides thorough medical care and procedures for birds, rodents, and other exotic animals.

q.en: Can the clinic accommodate multiple pets in one appointment?

a.en: Yes, reviewers mention that staff have coordinated schedules to evaluate multiple family pets together when circumstances require.

q.en: Do the doctors provide surgical procedures and post-operative follow-up?

a.en: Yes, pet owners report successful surgical procedures such as growth removals, accompanied by detailed follow-up evaluations.
